note: The (i) texts of the website for sample 01_analysis_personal, made by explain.js from analysis.rules, analysis.paper.marks and analysis.class.n. Not an API response.

texts.score: Score = sahi jawabon ke marks − galat jawabon par kate marks. Is paper mein sahi par +4, galat par -1, chhode par 0.
texts.rank: Is paper ke 14 students mein (har student ka pehla attempt; owner aur reviewer nahi ginte). Jitne students ka Score aapse zyada hai, usme 1 jodo. Barabar Score par Rank barabar.
texts.percentile: 100 × (jin students ka Score aapke barabar ya kam hai) ÷ kul students. Yeh sirf is paper ka hai, asli exam ka percentile nahi.
texts.accuracy: Accuracy = Sahi ÷ (Sahi + Galat) × 100. Chhode hue sawaal isme nahi ginte.
texts.time: Paper shuru hone se submit tak ka time. "Sawaalon par" = jitni der koi sawaal screen par khula raha. Tab chhupa ho to nahi ginta, aur ek baar mein zyada se zyada 15 minute.
texts.attempted: Jin sawaalon ka jawab diya: Sahi + Galat. Dropped ya sabko-bonus wale sawaal isme nahi.
texts.ledger: Kamaye = sahi jawabon ke marks. Negative mein kate = galat jawabon ki penalty. Reh gaye = galat ya chhode sawaalon ke poore marks jo mil sakte the. Kamaye + reh gaye = paper ke kul marks.
texts.next3: Teeno kaam isi attempt ke sawaalon se nikle hain. Jis kaam mein sabse zyada marks daav par hain, woh sabse upar. Koi AI nahi.
texts.standing: Sab students ke Score 10 barabar hisson mein baante gaye hain. Laal column woh hai jisme aapka Score aata hai.
texts.negative: Galat jawabon par kate marks ka jod.
texts.not_seen: Jo sawaal ek baar bhi screen par nahi khula.
texts.chapters: Mazboot = Accuracy 75% ya zyada. Kamzor = 40% se kam. Beech mein Theek. 3 se kam sawaal wale chapter par koi label nahi. Marks gaye = galat par (marks + negative) aur chhode par marks.
texts.vs_class: Topper kam se kam 2 students par dikhta hai. Class average aur Top 10% kam se kam 10 students par.
texts.realistic: Abhi ka Score + Careless galti ke poore marks + mushkil par risk ke poore marks + atke time wale step ka aadha.
texts.maximum: Abhi ka Score + teeno step ke poore marks. Paper ke kul marks se zyada nahi.
texts.careless: Jo sawaal Par ke 0.5 guna se kam time mein galat hue. Sahi hote to har ek par +5 (4 milte, -1 nahi katte).
texts.guard: Tough sawaal jo class mein 25% se kam students se bane aur aapse galat hue. Chhod dete to negative bachta. Class ka data 10 students ke baad hi ginta hai.
texts.reinvest: Atka time = Mehnga overtime mein Par se upar ka time + Confused sawaalon ka poora time. Yeh time chhode hue sawaalon ko diya gaya (Easy pehle), aapki apni Accuracy par.
texts.guess: Break-even = penalty ÷ (sahi ke marks + penalty). +4 / -1 par 20%.
texts.par: Par time = us sawaal ka ideal time. 30 ya zyada students ne sahi kiya ho to unka beech ka (median) time. Warna paper standard: paper ke 90% time ka hissa, Numerical ko MCQ se zyada.
texts.perfect: Sahi jawab, aur time Par ke 1.25 guna tak.
texts.wasted: Galat jawab, aur time Par ke 0.5 guna se kam.
texts.overtime: Sahi par Par ke 1.25 guna se zyada time (Slow-correct), ya galat par 1.5 guna se zyada (Mehnga overtime).
texts.confused: Jawab nahi diya, phir bhi Par ke 0.5 guna se zyada time laga.
texts.concept_gap: Galat jawab, time Par ke 0.5 se 1.5 guna ke beech.
texts.speed_map: Har dot ek sawaal. Baayein-daayein = aapka time ÷ Par time. Teen line: Sahi, Galat, Chhoda. Upar-neeche ka halka fark sirf dots ko alag dikhane ke liye hai.
texts.lucky: Sahi jawab jo Par ke 25% se kam time mein aaya. Yeh alag tag nahi, sirf ek note hai.
texts.painful: Galat jawab, aur time Par se zyada. Sabse zyada time wala sabse pehle.
texts.elapsed: Paper shuru hone se submit tak.
texts.on_screen: Jitni der koi sawaal screen par khula raha, sab sawaalon ka jod.
texts.off_screen: Paper mein laga time − sawaalon par screen time. Tab band, app background ya instructions padhne ka time.
texts.time_share: Time ka hissa = us subject par laga screen time ÷ kul screen time. Marks ka hissa = us subject ke marks ÷ paper ke kul marks.
texts.first_look: Pehli nazar = jawab usi visit mein diya jab sawaal pehli baar khula. Wapas aakar = baad ki kisi visit mein diya.
texts.last: Aapke kul time ka aakhri 20%. Dono taraf 5 ya zyada jawab hon tabhi yeh compare banta hai.
texts.pace: Paper ke time ko 20 barabar hisson mein baanta. Har point: tab tak kul kitne jawab diye ja chuke the (pehli baar jawab dene ka time).
texts.difficulty: 50 ya zyada students ne attempt kiya ho to: 65% ya zyada sahi = Easy, 35% se kam = Tough, beech mein Moderate. 10 se 49 students par wahi hisaab "shuruaati" likh kar. Warna paper ka apna tag. Warna Not rated.
texts.leak: Easy sawaal jo galat hue (marks + negative) ya chhoot gaye (marks).
texts.streak: Jis order mein aapne jawab diye, usme lagataar sahi (ya lagataar galat) jawabon ki sabse lambi line.
texts.changes: Pehla diya jawab vs aakhri jawab. Galat se sahi: +5. Sahi se galat: −5. Galat se galat: 0.
texts.journey: Visit = ek baar sawaal khola aur us par ruke. Beech mein tab chhupa ho to bhi woh ek hi visit hai.
texts.gap: Volume = unke zyada attempts × unke marks per attempt. Quality = aapke attempts × (unke marks per attempt − aapke). Dono ka jod = kul gap.
